notes.title: Eastern Game Fest Dicount
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

AngerForce: Reloaded is excited to announce that we are now taking part in Eastern Game Fest held by Steam China!
During the event, "Game Name" will enjoy a time-limited discount.
Special Offer: XX% OFF. 
You can have the game in your library with only $7.49!
Discounted period will expire till 10 AM/ Apr. 19 2023. 

AngerForce: Reloaded is expecting to meet with all die-hard game curators during this Eastern Game Fest.
Link to the featured page of Eastern Game Fest: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/easterngamesfest

notes.title: Join the Zodiac Community!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We wanted to offer a big “thank you” to all those who play our games and have supported us at Zodiac Interactive. We hope you have been enjoying the experience, and we’re excited to bring new and awesome titles your way soon!

To keep up to date with our games, get access to sneak peeks of upcoming titles, and just generally sound off with other like-minded gamers, stop by our Discord server and say hi!
https://discordapp.com/invite/WNcJduT

Also, we’ve recently launched a Kickstarter campaign for our upcoming cyberpunk adventure Tales of the Neon Sea! We’re very excited about this project, and our team is working hard to deliver the best experience possible. For more details, visit our Kickstarter page here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/zodiacinteractive/tales-of-the-neon-sea-retro-styled-pixel-art-adven

Also our twitter:
https://twitter.com/ZdcInteractive

Thanks again to all our fantastic players!

notes.title: Bug Fix
Bug Fix
Hello, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30479461/b8a03e2d8b187648787bbf0877c193fbfc9aeb96.jpg[/img]
[h1]What's new:[/h1]
[list]
[*]ARCADE game mode with its own leaderboards.
[*]New upgradables in arcade mode.
[*]Permanent upgradables for campaign mode.
[*]Continue playing after death in campaign mode.
[*]In game health upgrading has been removed.
[/list]
[h1]Optimization:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Tutorial is only available in e[img][/img]asy mode.
[*]Optimized performance when player collecting points.
[*]More customizations in option menu.
[*]Added tips when game over.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixing:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed score rating.
[*]Fixed player description when returns to main menu.
[*]Fixed upgradables when restart within game.
[*]Fixed upgradables for replay.
[*]Fixed volume of voice overs.
[*]Fixed Dora's blur effect remains after death.
[*]Fixed game speed with high refresh rate moniters.
[/list]

notes.title: Leaderboard to be Cleared
notes.notes:
Sorry to announce this, but we found some inconsistencies when replaying records on the leaderboards.

We are fixing this issue right now, and are going to push the update around 4 pm today.

The leaderboard will be reset soon after the new version is live. But player's progress will not be affected.

Sorry again!
